meta.title: {name} {'|'} Core HR and talent development on one platform
meta.description: From onboarding, attendance and payroll to performance reviews, technical reviews and promotions, {name} brings core HR and talent development together, configured around the way your company works.

hero.title1: Let the system run the process.
hero.description: Onboarding, attendance, leave and payroll, plus performance reviews, technical reviews, promotions and probation. {name} keeps core HR and talent development in one place, follows your own policies, and routes every step to the right person.

proof.caption: Teams that run HR and talent development on {name}

peopleBand.quote: Behind every review and every promotion is someone's next step.

statement.text: HR isn't really about forms. It's about people. From someone's first day to every promotion, {name} keeps the process moving, so you have time to help them take the next step.

platform.title: Core HR and talent development, finally in the same place.
platform.description: Employee data is maintained once. Attendance and payroll use it, and so do reviews and promotions. When the org chart changes, approvals and reviews follow automatically.

configure.label: Configurable reviews
configure.title: Add a new review type without waiting on engineers.
configure.desc: Set the steps, questions, eligibility and visibility in the admin console. While you edit a flow, a live preview shows who each step would go to. Question changes are saved as a draft and apply to new cycles once published.

points.p1: Configure steps, owners and due dates
points.p2: Versioned questions, so reviews in progress stay untouched
points.p3: Start from scratch or copy an existing template

routing.label: Automatic routing
routing.title: Every step goes to the person who owns it.
routing.desc: Direct managers, skip-level managers, reviewers chosen by the employee, one form per peer. Set the rule once and the system assigns people from the org chart. After a reorg, steps that are not yet submitted are reassigned.

points.p1: Finds managers from the org chart, including vacancies and acting heads
points.p2: Employees can choose their reviewers, and each one scores separately
points.p3: Reorgs reassign open steps, submitted ones stay as they are

payroll.label: Attendance to payroll
payroll.title: From clock-in to payday, entered only once.
payroll.desc: Attendance, leave and overtime flow into payroll automatically. Insurance, pension and income tax are calculated as you go, and digital payslips go straight to employees.

points.p1: GPS and Wi-Fi clock-in with flexible shifts
points.p3: Bank transfer files in one click

trust.title: Who can see what, explained at every step.
trust.description: HR data is as sensitive as it gets. {name} checks permissions on the server for every action, not just by hiding buttons on screen.

roles.title: Layered permissions
roles.desc: Platform admins, the HR owners of each review type, managers and employees each see only what they should.

visibility.title: Configurable visibility
visibility.desc: Decide when employees see each review. For example, 1-on-1 notes appear once submitted and development plans stay hidden from the employee.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.desc: Every view and every change is recorded: who, when and which record.

encryption.title: Encryption and backups
encryption.desc: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with daily backups.

cases.title: They took their time back from the process.
cases.note: Company names, people, quotes and figures are illustrative samples for this proposal.

global.quote: We used to run a spreadsheet in each office. Now it is one employee record and one review flow, and each office HR looks after its own people.

tech.quote: Employees pick their technical reviewers and each one scores separately, so promotion results feel fair. And nobody emails back and forth to book panels anymore.
tech.m1l: average time to book a panel

growth.quote: Probation starts the day someone joins, managers get a reminder on day 65, and no one slips past day 100 anymore.

steps.title: Three steps to your new system.
steps.description: A dedicated consultant stays with you throughout. Start with a pilot in one department, no IT team needed.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.desc: We learn your organisation, shifts, pay rules and review policies, then recommend a rollout plan.

setup.title: Data import and setup
setup.desc: We import employees and the org chart, then set up approval flows, pay items and review templates.

launch.title: Training and go-live
launch.desc: We train HR and managers, and keep supporting you after launch.

modules.q: Can we use just part of the platform?
modules.a: Yes. Core HR and talent development can be rolled out separately and extended later, all on the same employee data.

customize.q: Can review flows and questions follow our own policies?
customize.a: Yes. Each review type's steps, owners, questions, eligibility and visibility are set in the admin console, and adding a new type needs no code.

install.q: Do we need to install software or run servers?
install.a: No. Sign in from a browser or phone, and we take care of updates.

migrate.q: Can we bring data over from our old system?
migrate.a: Yes. We provide import templates, and a consultant helps check and convert your existing data.

security.a: Every action is permission-checked on the server, data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and every view and change is in the audit trail.

pricing.a: By number of users and modules. Book a demo and we'll put together a quote for your needs.

cta.title: See how {name} fits the way you work.
cta.description: Book a 30-minute online demo. A consultant will walk through it using your organisation and processes, and suggest how to roll it out.
